_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic#6. <analysis>STATIC</analysis> in a biphasic deck gives 'tag "analysis" (line N) : invalid value: STATIC' — a clean parse error, not a silent fallback. The second half is executed rather than inferred: <analysis>1</analysis> is accepted, runs to normal termination, and its logged element sz;p match the TRANSIENT run bit for bit while differing from the STEADY-STATE run — so the raw ordinal really does select TRANSIENT here. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'analysis_enum_scope=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
